positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Senior Programmer "Mass Effect" (2007) - XBox 360:
- designed and implemented the cinematic system
- designed and implemented the save game system
- jointly designed and implemented the conversation and stage systems
- technical advisor for the Digital Actors Group
- added C++, Unrealscript and Kismet code into an Unreal project

Assistant Lead Programmer "Jade Empire" (2005) -  XBox:
- jointly prototyped the game design
- jointly designed the game object system
- integrated and expanded the AI and conversation systems in response to designer needs
- implemented the pathfinding and path following systems
- integrated system framework including file system, memory management and GUI
- ensured XBox certification requirements were fulfilled

Senior Programmer "Neverwinter Nights" (2002) - PC:
- designed and implemented the conversation system
- redesigned and implemented the data file format making existing files 10 times faster and half the size
- implemented major parts of the Dungeon Master tool

Senior Programmer "Baldur's Gate II" (2000) - PC:
- implemented the 3D graphics engine
- extended the 2D graphics engine to support higher resolutions
- extended the path following system to better handle mobile objects

Programmer "Baldur's Gate: Tales Of The Sword Coast" (1999) - PC:
- designed and implemented the GUI system
- designed and implemented the pathfinding and path following systems
- designed and implemented the visual effects system

Programmer "Baldur's Gate" (1998) - PC:
- designed and implemented the GUI system
- designed and implemented the pathfinding and path following systems
- designed and implemented the visual effects system
